domains.name: Director Office, strategy and management mandates
Company secretary, board, external audit and legal services
Company administration and three branch commercial structures
Sales, tender intelligence and client relationship management
Contract, insurance, mobilization, billing and client exit
Guard operations, dispatch, patrol and service verification
Central Monitoring System, video, AI, IoT, access and incident command
Arms Control, armoury, vault CCTV and armed-client operations
HR administration, payroll preparation, staff relations and training
Foreign workers, hostels, welfare, safety, transport and fleet
SQL Account, treasury, payroll accounting and financial planning
Procurement, warehouse, uniforms and equipment lifecycle
Property, technology, fleet and fixed-asset maintenance
Licences, statutory compliance, tax and corporate obligation calendar
PWVSB financing, credit licences, collateral and enforcement
Internal audit, anti-fraud, integrity and assurance
Privacy, data security, legal hold and records retention
CTO, super-app engineering, cyber resilience and delivery
Business continuity, executive escalation, crisis and closed-loop assurance

sops.title: Annual group strategic plan
steps: Collect entity-level results and risks
Set growth, margin, cash and compliance objectives by company and region
Model scenarios with Finance and COO
Present trade-offs to Chairman and Vice Chairman
Approve versioned strategy, owners and quarterly milestones

sops.title: Quarterly director office operating review
steps: Obtain signed finance and COO scorecards
Identify top ten exceptions and accountable people
Circulate agenda and pre-reads
Minute decisions, dissent and due dates
Chase closure evidence at next session

sops.title: Board-authority and delegation verification
steps: Retrieve signed management agreement and company board resolution
Map permitted action, value cap, entity and expiry
Screen conflicts and regulatory restrictions
Obtain Legal and CoS independent check
Publish restricted rights to approval engine

sops.title: Executive instruction case
steps: Record purpose, subject entity and authorized issuer
Determine responsible central department and company manager
Require acknowledgment, milestones and supporting records
Escalate overdue work without altering statutory accountability
Close only on reviewed deliverable

sops.title: Management agreement renewal
sops.trigger: Agreement due or material service change
steps: Compare service scope and payment/authority schedules
Obtain legal and affected company director review
Reconcile changes with mandate register
Secure properly executed renewal or board authorization
Update service catalogue and notify Finance / Operations

sops.title: Decision exception or appeal
steps: Preserve original decision and objections
Assess urgency and correct decision authority
Obtain opinion from Legal / Finance / Compliance as needed
Escalate unresolved cases to CEO or board
Record final rationale, remedy and notification

sops.title: Group KPI and assurance dashboard
steps: Pull authorized aggregated status by legal entity
Validate stale feeds and missing records
Highlight uncovered posts, liquidity and statutory risks
Allocate action to the named owner
Publish CEO summary with linked evidence not unsupported totals

sops.title: Director Office hosted meeting
steps: Issue agenda and verified attendance
Capture decisions, conditions, owners and due dates
Separate pending decisions from approved actions
Circulate for chair verification
Track action completion and archive versioned minutes

sops.title: New legal entity dossier
steps: Verify SSM registration, directors, shareholders and addresses
Store company constitution, mandates, licences and bank references
Appoint one company manager and three admin executives where required
Create company compliance calendar
Validate read rights and statutory reporting ownership

sops.title: SSM annual return monitoring
sops.target: Start 60 days prior; statutory deadline separately verified
steps: Confirm anniversary and legal filing rule
Request particulars from company manager and secretary
Reconcile directors/shareholders and registered address
Obtain approved annual return and lodgement proof
Store SSM acknowledgement and check accepted status

sops.title: Financial statements circulation and filing
steps: Confirm actual statutory deadlines for entity
Track close and external-audit readiness
Obtain signed financial statements and board approval
Coordinate circulation and lodgement by secretary
Verify SSM acceptance and retain final audit file

sops.title: Directors or shareholders change
steps: Obtain proper resolutions and instrument evidence
Check KDN, KPKT and other regulator approval effects
Screen beneficial ownership/related party impact
Instruct company secretary under authorized mandate
Validate registry filings before declaring change complete

sops.title: Beneficial-ownership assessment
sops.target: Same day flag; assessment within 5 workdays
steps: Identify real individuals with relevant control or interests
Inspect shareholder and contractual control evidence
Obtain company secretary/legal determination
Submit applicable statutory updates when required
Restrict access and preserve reasoning

sops.title: Board meeting and resolution
steps: Confirm quorum, conflict declarations and signing power
Circulate precise paper and draft resolution
Record votes and terms without presuming assent
Obtain signed minutes and required company filings
Update mandate and action registers

sops.title: Company secretary performance
steps: Reconcile statutory calendar to accepted filings
Inspect overdue requests and missed reminders
Check retention of signed originals and registers
Validate retainer/disbursement invoices
Correct deficiencies or initiate adviser replacement

sops.title: External auditor engagement
steps: Assess appointment and independence requirements
Obtain fee, scope and signed engagement
Confirm entity ledger close and PBC list
Coordinate board approvals where applicable
Open protected audit workspace with deadlines

sops.title: External audit PBC and findings
steps: Log each request with entity and owner
Provide signed trial balance, bank reconciliations and support
Track auditor questions and proposed adjustments
Obtain Finance approval before posting journal
Close findings only with auditor confirmation or documented disagreement

sops.title: Legal firm appointment and case management
steps: Verify counsel standing, independence and conflicts
Secure scoped engagement, fee budget and authority
Track privileged instructions, evidence and deadlines separately
Obtain authorized settlement or litigation instructions
Review legal bill and court outcome before closure

sops.title: Litigation deadline and legal hold
steps: Capture received date and originals
Notify company directors and appointed counsel confidentially
Freeze relevant footage, email and transaction deletion
Monitor hearings, directions and response dates
Record judgment, appeal, settlement and claim ledger consequences

sops.title: Branch manager onboarding and agreement
steps: Check approved KDN branch permissions and partner diligence
Select Model A, B or C from signed terms
Define collection, spending, employment and signing mandates
Configure company/branch/site codes and access
Verify first-month governance and CMS links

sops.title: Model A variable billing percentage
steps: Identify eligible invoicing base and exclusions from agreement
Apply effective-dated contractual percentage, never hardcoded 6%
Calculate company allocation and branch expense responsibility
Reconcile invoices, credits, cash, taxes and disputes in SQL
Issue checked settlement statement and authorized disbursement

sops.title: Model B salaried company branch
steps: Confirm salary and bonus terms independent of branch collections
Record all revenue/expenses at correct legal entity
Reconcile attendance and payroll remittance
Compute company branch contribution
Send manager performance review with no unauthorized profit entitlement

sops.title: Model C configurable net profit share
steps: Confirm agreement-specific profit definition and period
Accrue approved wages, relief, taxes, utilities, claims and shared-service costs
Reconcile receivables, prepayments, fixed costs and reserves
Allocate contractual 50/60/custom percentages on approved net result
Obtain maker-checker and manager acknowledgment before settlement

sops.title: New branch bank account or signing rights
steps: Determine legal bank account holder and KDN agreement implications
Obtain relevant board resolution and bank KYC
Limit signatories and set dual approval
Map account into SQL bank reconciliation
Inform Audit and revoke obsolete access

sops.title: Branch-originated tender or lead
steps: Enter client, scope, site and commercial owner
Screen KDN licence and permitted geographic coverage
Submit pricing and credit check to central team
Obtain proper company approval and sign only if delegated
Track award and integrate mobilization

sops.title: Branch payroll and statutory assurance
steps: Match guards to legal employer and verified site hours
Reconcile wages/OT/leave and statutory deductions
Obtain HR and Finance independent checks
Release salary from properly authorized legal-entity account
Investigate rejected transactions or underpayments immediately

sops.title: Branch capital advance and repayment
sops.trigger: Approved cash gap or equipment financing
steps: Obtain cash budget, borrower entity and use-of-funds
Check lending authority, related-party and KPKT applicability
Execute approved loan/security instruments where required
Match disbursement and subsequent payments to both ledgers
Monitor aging, covenant breaches and repayment waterfall

sops.title: Branch closure, termination and handover
sops.target: 30-day controlled plan unless urgent legal action
steps: Verify notice/step-in rights and KDN implications
Secure payroll continuity and active clients
Reconcile cash, branch property, stock and outstanding advances
Revoke system/bank credentials on authorized date
Sign final branch statement and preserve disputes

sops.title: Branch manager monthly scorecard
steps: Verify earned revenue, DSO and aged debt
Check CMS site fulfillment, HR grievances and incident rates
Assess margins after adjusted costs and unbilled service
Discuss performance and corrective steps with manager
Route legal breaches separately from commercial negotiation

sops.title: Government tender discovery
steps: Search approved government eTender portals and tender feeds
Confirm security service scope and eligibility company
Log briefing, site visit, bond and submission deadlines
Assign bid owner in correct company
Monitor submission status and exceptions until outcome

sops.title: Private sector prospecting
steps: Enter client contact and site requirements
Check conflicts, client credit and scope of licence
Assign site survey and price-development tasks
Record visits, proposals and follow-ups
Advance stages only with dated evidence

sops.title: Bid/no-bid decision
sops.target: Within 2 working days of discovery where possible
steps: Quantify site posts/hours, compliance and mobilisation cost
Confirm manpower and relief availability with COO
Assess client credit, guarantees and risk
Obtain delegated pricing/negative-margin approval
Record decision, conditions and accountable team

sops.title: Site survey and threat/vulnerability assessment
sops.trigger: Tender shortlisted or material contract change
steps: Visit site with client consent and safety brief
Document posts, access points, assets, risks and technology interfaces
Define manpower, rest and response requirements
Obtain risk mitigations and client acceptance
Version drawings/post orders and cost assumptions

sops.title: Pricing proposal and approvals
sops.target: At least 2 days before tender submission
steps: Price contracted hours separately from payroll-ready time
Include relief, employer costs, accommodation, insurance, devices and taxes
Stress test margin and collection terms
Obtain Finance, COO and appropriate company sign-off
Lock versioned quote and append service assumptions

sops.title: Tender briefing and mandatory documents
steps: Book required representatives and credentials
Attend and document amendments/site conditions
Gather relevant licence, MOF, audited accounts and certificates
Conduct independent completeness check
Lodge and retain submission acknowledgement

sops.title: Client credit and reputational assessment
steps: Verify legal name, beneficial client identifiers and references
Review payment history, disputes and risk concentration
Propose exposure, deposits, limits and credit terms
Obtain Finance authorization and escalation if exception
Schedule ongoing reassessment and aging actions

sops.title: Client satisfaction and service review
steps: Review SLA, incidents, complaints and site coverage
Validate disputed evidence with Operations
Meet client and record actions and dates
Escalate material contract changes to controlled variations
Confirm closure and client acknowledgment

sops.title: Client renewal and upsell
steps: Review margin, insurance and SLA penalties
Reassess rates, labour/technology changes and risks
Negotiate signed variation or replacement contract
Verify company approvals and effective date
Update Finance/Operations without rewriting historic rates

sops.title: Contract creation and signing
steps: Validate award letter, scope, employing/licensed entity
Map variable 3/5/12/15/custom coverage to service schedules
Agree 30.5 / fixed monthly / calendar billing basis
Verify insurance, SLA, termination and indemnity clauses
Obtain authorized signatures and controlled effective date

sops.title: Insurance certificate and endorsement
steps: Read exact contractual coverage requirement and limits
Confirm named insured, site, risks, exclusions and excess
Obtain insurer/broker written binding evidence
Record endorsements, premiums, expiry and claim contacts
Release readiness gate only after independent check

sops.title: New site mobilisation case
sops.trigger: Signed award or permitted mobilisation instruction
steps: Create tasks for Finance, HR, Operations, equipment and Compliance
Verify JTKSM, PERKESO, KDN, Immigration applicability by entity/site
Complete guard site induction, roster and relief plan
Commission CCTV/NFC/ANPR and test emergency escalation
Secure client acceptance and GM go-live sign-off

sops.title: Guard-specific site readiness
steps: Verify identity, legal employer, permit and training
Check shift/hours/rest and transport/hostel availability
Issue site-specific post orders and uniform/equipment
Obtain guard induction and attendance credential acknowledgment
Record HR and Ops authorization or block deployment

sops.title: Service commencement and first invoice
steps: Confirm actual accepted service start date and contract version
Match attendance/service evidence to contractual hours
Apply rate, allowed adjustment, tax and PO references
Review unbilled earned service, accruals and invoice status
Send approved invoice and monitor collection

sops.title: Contract variation and site expansion
sops.trigger: Client requests changed scope / rates / posts
steps: Issue change request with financial and HR effect
Reassess insurance, permit, HSE and equipment requirements
Obtain customer and company signed variation
Version effective rates, schedules, SLAs and cover
Reissue relevant post orders and billing instructions

sops.title: Complaint and SLA dispute
sops.target: Acknowledge same day or contract SLA
steps: Register facts, severity and contractual clock
Protect CCTV/NFC/incident evidence and investigate
Agree remedial owner and client communication
Submit authorized credits/penalties via Finance
Independently validate closure and trend recurrence

sops.title: Incident insurer notification and claims
sops.trigger: Damage, loss, liability or legal claim
sops.target: Immediately on material incident; insurer term governs
steps: Protect evidence and notify site/insurer under policy terms
Confirm applicable policy, excess and insured parties
Manage adjuster requests and legal privilege
Record reserve, payment, recovery and coverage dispute
Close only after claim settlement and ledger reconciliation

sops.title: Client renewal governance
steps: Review service, margin, finance collections and claims
Negotiate updated terms and pricing
Verify licences, insurance and key personnel
Obtain legal and company signatory acceptance
Schedule revised coverage and customer communications

sops.title: Client termination and exit
sops.target: Plan from notice; final review within 30 days of exit
steps: Validate notice and site security transition obligations
Redeploy guards and close access credentials
Recover equipment, keys and evidence assets
Reconcile final payroll, invoices, deposits, claims and unbilled revenue
Obtain documented client and Finance closure

sops.title: Annual guard demand and deployment capacity
steps: Forecast required guard hours by contract and site
Separate client 24/7 coverage from lawful guard working hours
Model relief, holidays, leave and standby reserves
Confirm HR recruitment/transfer and permit eligibility
Publish site manpower risk and cost forecast

sops.title: Daily roster publication
sops.target: Publish at least 24h before shift where feasible
steps: Read effective post order and required coverage windows
Assign trained legal employees respecting hours/rest
Allocate relief and contingency coverage
Check overlaps, leave, foreign permits and travel time
Freeze published roster with version/audit trail

sops.title: Shift check-in and attendance verification
sops.target: Exception flagged within 5 min of start (internal target)
steps: Verify named identity, approved device and site
Compare checked-in guard to expected post/window
Check missing, duplicate, offline or late evidence
Notify CMS and Ops for coverage gap
Confirm relief and reconcile attendance exception at end shift

sops.title: Uncovered post / no-show dispatch
steps: Confirm actual unfilled post and client risk
Contact site and available authorized relief
Escalate to Operations and client as agreed
Track deployment and verified physical arrival
Record service deficit and Finance SLA impact

sops.title: Rest and shift legality
steps: Classify actual worked time versus truly duty-free rest
Reconcile interruptions, standby and relief
Apply 45h-week and lawful OT logic with jurisdiction policy
Review unusual 12h shift templates and client coverage separately
Correct payroll-ready hours without distorting billed service

sops.title: Guard substitution or transfer
steps: Verify receiving site/client authorization
Check legal employer, job eligibility, rest and training
Arrange transport and necessary equipment
Update employee effective-dated deployment and CMS roster
Verify handover and first-check-in

sops.title: Patrolling officer route planning
steps: Prioritize contract-mandated and high-risk inspections
Set realistic driving order and visit windows
Check manager, vehicle and device assignments
Distribute unresolved previous findings
Obtain Operations sign-off and route backups

sops.title: Patrolling officer field inspection
sops.target: Report at departure; serious issue immediate
steps: Verify attendance/identity/uniform and post orders
Inspect logbook, NFC, CCTV and access incidents
Discuss wellbeing and client concerns discreetly
Capture authorized photos, grades and corrective tasks
Notify CMS/Operations for serious defects and close report

sops.title: NFC guard-tour scheduling and review
sops.target: Missing tour alert per route window
steps: Configure route/version/checkpoint requirements
Reconcile actual scan, integrity and offline receipt
Distinguish emergency/approved break from unperformed patrol
Open task for missed/tampered checkpoint
Require supervisory disposition and evidence

sops.title: Serious guard misconduct or service incident
sops.target: Immediate safety response; HR case same day
steps: Protect safety and witness accounts without prejudgment
Preserve site/CMS data and notify legal HR
Separate factual inquiry from discipline decision
Approve temporary coverage/replacement lawfully
Review client, insurance and corrective needs

sops.title: Regional deployment and state office review
steps: Review uncovered posts, lateness, PO misses and incidents
Check permits, accommodation, fleet and staffing gaps
Resolve local client requests within mandate
Escalate KDN/financial issues to HQ
Produce region scorecard and pending actions

sops.title: 24/7 CMS shift takeover
steps: Review active incident queue and unacknowledged alerts
Validate operator logins, communications and backup links
Hand over uncovered posts and unavailable cameras
Reassign cases with due escalation clocks
Sign incoming/outgoing handover record

sops.title: Live coverage surveillance
steps: Compare contracted posts against actual verified attendance
Correlate relief, roster and work status
Investigate failed/late feeds without assuming attendance
Dispatch according to severity policy
Confirm physical recovery and site/client notification

sops.title: Guard tour missed checkpoint alert
steps: Check route version and approved exceptions
Review latest NFC sync/network and guard status
Contact guard/site supervisor and assess welfare risk
Escalate missed round or suspected manipulation
Record root cause and verified subsequent patrol

sops.title: PO missing site visit
steps: Verify officer route and last authorized location event
Contact officer and Ops manager
Consider accident/communications issue before blame
Reassign required inspection or response
Document findings and close after verified visit

sops.title: CCTV live/recording health
steps: Confirm device online, storage, recording and permitted live preview
Cross-check power/network versus camera tamper signal
Notify site operator and IT/OEM support
Initiate compensating monitoring under approved site plan
Verify restored recording and preserve outage timestamps

sops.title: AI analytics alarm and human verification
steps: Verify source model, confidence and site rule
Assess video clip under minimum necessary access
Correlate guard/NFC/access/sensor context
Dispatch human responder for actionable threat
Classify false alert only with evidence and tuning feedback

sops.title: Barrier/ANPR event exception
steps: Confirm authorised entry policy and device health
Review ANPR confidence and matching entitlement
Check OEM interlocks and site fallback SOP
Escalate unsafe or suspicious movement
Record commands and overrides with named approval

sops.title: Turnstile/access-door alarms
sops.trigger: Forced entry, held door, denied credential
steps: Correlate device ID, access user and local emergency conditions
Verify legitimate visitor/employee authority
Contact guard and supervisor without unsafe egress override
Revoke compromised credential through approved IAM
Record outcome and verify reset

sops.title: Alarm-to-incident and dispatch
steps: Deduplicate and classify evidence from multiple devices
Start incident clock and assign response owner
Notify emergency services when SOP thresholds met
Capture dispatch, arrival, containment and client contact
Close only with authorized incident commander and evidence

sops.title: Emergency CMS continuity
steps: Declare degraded mode and impacted sites
Start fallback call tree and local patrol monitoring
Preserve event queues and edge recording
Escalate clients and statutory hazards as required
Validate failback reconciliation before normal status

sops.title: Incident postmortem and alarm tuning
sops.trigger: Major incident or repeat false positives
steps: Freeze incident chronology and underlying evidence
Compare SLA and operator responses to SOP
Determine people/process/device root cause
Approve corrective work and analytics tuning
Verify regression tests and residual risk acceptance

sops.title: Client CMS report and permissions
sops.trigger: Monthly report or customer access request
steps: Extract only permitted site and service data
Verify accuracy and redactions
Reconcile incidents, patrols and video availability
Obtain Ops/Compliance approval for release
Record customer acknowledgment and retention obligations

sops.title: Firearm legal entity and licence register
steps: Verify lawful owner/licensee, approvals and restricted identifiers
Verify individual authorized carry/use records and expiry
Associate only with permitted entity and activity
Obtain independent original-document check
Publish eligible status without exposing sensitive vault details

sops.title: Armed client contract readiness
steps: Confirm agency/armed-service authority and scope
Survey site risks and posts with legal/insurance check
Validate named staffing, firearms availability and storage plans
Agree client reporting and incident SLA terms
Obtain appropriate entity and client approvals

sops.title: Regulated firearm acquisition request
steps: Confirm whether acquisition/sale is legally permitted for entity
Request required regulator approvals and procurement diligence
Segregate legal documentation from ordinary purchase orders
Confirm insurance, custody and asset ledger classification
Record receipt only after authorized physical verification

sops.title: Approved vault/armoury establishment
steps: Verify location-specific lawful approvals and custodian
Assess licensed physical protection without publishing layout broadly
Test alarm, CCTV, access and backup communications
Record inventory baseline with dual-person count
Commission only with authorized signoff

sops.title: Arm issue, handover, movement and return
steps: Verify named permit, client/site and approved purpose
Confirm issuer/recipient identity and independent check where required
Record issue and movement with immutable time and asset ID
Monitor expected return and route exceptions without equating RFID with custody
Count and sign return; open discrepancy case immediately

sops.title: Ammunition accountability
sops.target: Verify at every issue/return and scheduled count
steps: Confirm approved opening quantity and lot
Document named issue and authorized purpose
Reconcile actual unused/returned quantities
Escalate any unexplained difference without self-adjustment
Review authorized adjustments independently and retain original ledger

sops.title: Vault CCTV and alarm assurance
steps: Verify vault feed, recording and time synchronization
Correlate access events with licensed custodian schedules
Escalate suspicious access, tamper or recording loss
Preserve original restricted video and access trail
Require Arms Control signoff before incident closure

sops.title: Armed guard pre-duty authorization
steps: Verify company and named person permits/competency
Match contract and approved post
Verify shift readiness and required documents
Confirm custodian custody record is complete
Block digital readiness when any critical authority invalid

sops.title: Arms physical count and independent audit
sops.target: Frequency per licensed condition; critical variance immediate
steps: Print signed freeze-time inventory listing
Perform authorized witnessed physical count
Reconcile movements and ammunition ledger
Escalate variance to responsible company/regulators as required
Obtain independent investigation closure and adjustment approval

sops.title: Arm maintenance, repair and return to service
steps: Quarantine out-of-service item under controlled custody
Verify lawful service provider and approval steps
Record chain of custody and relevant document references
Require inspection/permit verification for return
Release operational availability only after authorized signoff

sops.title: Armed incident, loss and regulator notification
sops.trigger: Missing arm, use allegation, unauthorized movement
steps: Secure public/personnel safety and preserve evidence
Notify appropriate licensed officer, police/regulator based on law
Reconcile affected inventory and incident timeline
Coordinate insurer, counsel and formal reports
Close only after externally required actions and independent audit

sops.title: Future arm trading product control
steps: Define separately licensed legal entity and permitted activities
Obtain government and specialist legal confirmation
Configure restricted trade, customer checks and import/export workflows
Complete cyber/safety and regulatory UAT
Enable production only after explicit board/license signoff

sops.title: Employee master and onboarding
steps: Verify identity, employer company and documentation
Assess medical/permit requirements without broad exposure
Create unique employee ID and role/site eligibility
Set payroll, statutory and bank details via maker-checker
Provide induction and data/privacy notice

sops.title: New guard recruitment and screening
steps: Verify approved headcount and site demand
Collect lawful recruitment screening and KDN checks
Assess training/fitness and employment eligibility
Approve contract and relevant documents
Release only verified candidate to roster pool

sops.title: Leave, sick leave and hospitalization
sops.target: Same day receipt; approval before payroll lock
steps: Verify employee entitlements by service/jurisdiction
Check document authenticity without unnecessary medical disclosure
Obtain supervisor and HR approval as applicable
Arrange compliant substitute for affected post
Update final payroll leave codes and archive evidence

sops.title: Office staff attendance and training
steps: Reconcile presence, leave and flexible rules
Identify required courses by job role
Schedule competent provider and signed attendance
Verify skills assessment and certificates
Record future renewals and escalation

sops.title: Guard CSG/TNG/role training
sops.trigger: New hire, quota gap or renewal
steps: Identify company-specific current annual rule version
Build trainee list with official quotas and eligible cohort
Obtain verified training attendance/completion
Update eSIMS readiness evidence where authorized
Report projected shortfall 90 days ahead

sops.title: Monthly timekeeping and OT review
steps: Reconcile roster, check-ins, PO evidence and approved exceptions
Apply correct work/rest, OT and holiday rates by legal rules
Verify leave, advances, claims and lawful deductions
Require Ops, HR, Finance sign-offs
Lock export snapshot to payroll and preserve prior version

sops.title: Salary bank file and payment confirmation
steps: Verify employees, account changes and summary totals
Independent review against roster and statutory records
Release via dual bank approval under employing entity
Reconcile bank rejections, unpaid salaries and returned funds
Confirm actual payslips and remittances without marking success prematurely

sops.title: Statutory contributions and payroll taxes
steps: Reconcile EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB applicable populations
Review exemptions/caps and employee changes
Approve and remit from correct employer entity
Reconcile acknowledgements to payroll and SQL
Escalate unpaid/rejected contributions immediately

sops.title: Employee grievance, safeguarding and appeal
steps: Protect complainant from retaliation and assess safety
Assign impartial investigator and preserve evidence
Offer response opportunity and policy-consistent process
Obtain independent HR/appropriate Vice Chairman decision
Record remedy/appeal and limit access

sops.title: Disciplinary process and termination
steps: Verify allegations, law, notice and impartiality
Conduct necessary inquiry with records and representation rights
Obtain authorized proportionate outcome
Calculate final pay/benefits and statutory steps
Disable access/return assets and retain lawful records

sops.title: Foreign-worker medical allowance
steps: Check eligible employee and RM200 annual limit
Verify receipts without exposing clinical details
Maintain running annual ledger and reject duplicate claims
Approve reimbursement according to policy
Reconcile amounts with payroll/Finance and reset annually

sops.title: Headcount, compensation and promotion governance
steps: Present approved headcount, pay bands and role impacts
Check company labour and budget implications
Obtain Vice Chairman final HR approval for delegated matters
Issue change letter and update access duties
Track performance and approval trail

sops.title: Foreign-worker recruitment and quota
steps: Check KDN employer status and approved recruitment demand
Confirm lawful recruitment fees/agency and documents
Coordinate Section 60K/attestation/VDR as applicable
Verify arrival, Immigration, screening and permits
Activate roster eligibility only after signed legal checks

sops.title: PLKS/FOMEMA and immigration renewal
steps: Verify rule/eligibility and work permit holder
Schedule required medical and government steps
Track portal appointment and receipts
Escalate failures/restrictions and stop unauthorized duty
Store renewed permit and employer status before release

sops.title: Worker deployment and worksite changes
sops.trigger: Worker transferred or client opens site
steps: Confirm permitted employer and sector/location conditions
Assess KDN/JTK/PERKESO update applicability
Validate new accommodation and transport assignment
Amend employee effective-dated site and contact information
Obtain check-in and welfare confirmation

sops.title: Worker home leave, re-entry and final return
sops.target: Start 30-90 days before travel as needed
steps: Check documents/re-entry visa and work obligations
Reserve or release hostel bed per approved terms
Arrange travel and notify payroll/Operations
Reconcile return or final wages and lawful Check Out process
Close with signed exit/repatriation proof

sops.title: Hostel demand, sourcing and approvals
sops.trigger: New manpower or CLQ capacity gap
steps: Confirm number of eligible persons by region
Inspect property tenure, safety and local law
Verify JTKSM/Act446/PBT applicability and required certificates
Approve lease/CLQ cost/deposit via Finance
Open beds only when legal evidence is verified

sops.title: Hostel room and bed allocation
steps: Validate available certified capacity and occupancy rules
Assign unique employee to room/bed effective dates
Record keys, furniture, condition and tenant info
Complete required placement notices where applicable
Monitor check-in/out and protect privacy

sops.title: Hostel inspection and defect resolution
sops.target: Immediate if unsafe; routine per signed plan
steps: Inspect safety, occupancy, sanitation, appliances and utilities
Photograph defects proportionately without exposing occupants
Prioritize urgent repairs and accommodation relocation
Assign vendor and track close-out evidence
Verify compliance and worker welfare before reopening

sops.title: Hostel rent/CLQ invoice reconciliation
steps: Compare contracted minimum/actual bed basis to occupancy
Check landlord invoices, inclusions and meter readings
Prevent electricity/water double charge
Apply internal RM30 electricity/RM20 water budgets as variance only
Approve matched invoice and investigate disputes

sops.title: Fleet allocation and preventive servicing
steps: Confirm licensed company ownership/lease and approved use
Check road tax, insurance, driver eligibility and tracker
Schedule OEM servicing and defect remediation
Allocate mileage/fuel to contract/branch
Capture cost, downtime and replacement plan

sops.title: Guard transport route and missed pickup
sops.target: Plan previous day; missed pickup immediate
steps: Publish route, assigned vehicle/driver and worker list
Verify hostel-to-site travel and handover
Detect late/missed pickups and alert Operations
Dispatch safe replacement to preserve contract coverage
Reconcile trip logs, wage impact and cost

sops.title: Occupational safety hazard assessment
sops.trigger: Site start, incident or material change
steps: Identify operational hazards and client co-control responsibilities
Assess risks and preventive measures with guards
Issue safe work instructions, PPE and emergency contacts
Obtain acceptance and training evidence
Schedule reassessment and monitor unresolved risks

sops.title: Workplace injury/near miss/reporting
sops.target: Immediate aid; statutory time determined by rule
steps: Provide emergency assistance and prevent repeat harm
Preserve accurate incident facts and witness evidence
Determine DOSH reporting applicability and timeframe
Notify insurer/PERKESO/client where applicable

sops.trigger: Scheduled annual review or law change
steps: List every SOP owner, last review and legal dependencies
Incorporate incident lessons and changed contracts
Seek correct legal/regulator confirmation
Publish version with required acknowledgements
Test next case against updated decision logic

sops.title: Operational internal control effectiveness
sops.trigger: Monthly dashboard and quarterly deep dive
steps: Compare completed cases to supporting evidence and actual bank/agency records
Sample late statutory, payroll, CMS and approvals
Identify false 'closed' statuses and ineffective controls
Assign remediation owners and independent retest dates
Report persistent exceptions to CEO/board

sops.title: Case backlog and recurring follow-up
sops.owner: Chief of Staff / Director Office Administrator
steps: Rank cases by legal due, client harm and value
Identify unowned, stale and blocked tasks
Assign one accountable human and verifier
Escalate overdue P1/P2 through matrix
Close on proof not tick-box completion
